commits.message:
fix(links): a carousel, swatches row or picker link carries its step, so N clicks land N moves (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7qi) (#955)

* fix(links): a stepping link carries its step and lands where the key stands when the click arrives (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7qi)

A carousel's or swatches row's ◀ ▶, the swatches `?` and a picker's page
arrows wrote the option or page the draw had computed. A terminal keeps the
link it found when the mouse last moved, so every click after the first wrote
the same neighbour and the control moved once however many times it was
clicked.

The link now names the action and the step (ring-state, ring-config,
turn-page). The handler resolves the ring from the clicking session's config
and the value the bar wears when the click arrives, so N clicks move N steps
and `?` is one link on every draw that lands an option other than the one
held. A picker's page layout rides in the link as runs of pages, since only
the draw knows where the width broke them; a swatches step turns the page
holding its landing in the same handler, because a persist write lands a turn
later. Swatches no longer reads the clock, so the extra clock-function channel
is removed.

* fix(links): a ring step starts from the layer's file for persist, from the rule's name for a rule-chosen key, and refuses a stale page layout (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7qi)

Law review pass 1 on #955.

* fix(links): one owner for each ring input — a read-back refusal every centred control shares, a loud refusal for a link missing its centre or a layout that places no page, a whole-millisecond random seed (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7qi)

* fix(links): a swatches row over a key no variable reads back draws as it did, instead of throwing in the render (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7qi)

* test(links): the ambient-chrome filters and the durable-links check know the ring and page-arrow verbs (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7qi)

fix(stored-state): a per-session file that cannot be read shows ⚠ and survives the next save, and a restart at the bound keeps the sessions in use (candybar-law-review-ibyq.6iz)

One holder now holds every per-session file: the session book, and a renderer profile's picks and history. It reads the file once, by the rule every state file keeps. A file that does not read is renamed aside beside itself before anything is written, and the store starts empty. A file that can be neither read nor renamed is never saved to, and stands on every bar as saving nothing.

A load's set-aside and what it dropped (a refused session, a retired pick or setting, an empty session) are a daemon event about the file, grouped by what and why.

Recency is the last request or write. A request moves its session in the renderer's stores, and the host hears that as a `heard` write; the wire version goes to 18. A move of place alone reaches the file within one order period and at a close, so the write rate does not grow with the tick.
fix(state): a write over a state file that did not read sets it aside, and an unread answers book asks again (candybar-law-review-ibyq.6iz)
